$description.en_us: Forging methods this tool unlocks. At least one entry, and no duplicates. Tools placed in the table's three tool slots widen the method list; the usable methods are always the blueprint's allowed set intersected with the union of every placed tool's methods.
$description.zh_cn: 该工具解锁的全部锻打方式，至少一项且不可重复。锻造台右侧三格放入工具后其解锁的方式才会出现；可用方法始终是蓝图 allowed_methods 与所有已放置工具 methods 的并集的交集。
